title: Keep historical executions separate from definitions
preconditions: A case has pinned code evidence and legacy execution history; preserve a copy of its definition query and status.

steps.action: Compare assembled status for the fixture containing passed, failed and absent runs with the same fixture after all run metadata is removed.
steps.expected_result: The full assembled status is equal.

steps.action: Starting from the no-run fixture, use proposed lifecycles, conflicting run heads and a failed stale head run.
steps.expected_result: Quality criterion definition coverage is unchanged.

expected_result: Keep historical executions separate from definitions.
